text_block_list.text:
On the morning of tryouts, Umamusume
get ready to show off their
skills in hopes
of being scouted by spectating trainers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Uwaaagh! It's sooo touching!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
No matter the distance, they have the guts
to move forward, step by
tiny step!  They
don't give in, even with those little bodies!
Be brave
and carry that huge load!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Wahaaagh! It's so... It's so amaziiing!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: You're amazing, little ants!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Right! Ants are the best!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: They're trying... so hard! Waaaaa!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Wait! Don't tell me! You're gearing to go
after watching them too, am
I right?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know just how you feel! Seeing
them work their hearts out
really boosts
my spirits! Fills me with courage! Sets my
soul on fiiire!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'm exactly the same! Today's a super
important race, but now I know I
can blast
through it!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: The ants got me ready to win, and I've made a new friend who's as pumped from watching them as I am...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I'm WAAAY happy! Whoo-hooo!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Oh geez, she thinks I'm into ants...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey... Would you stop screaming? It's still
morning, and your yelling's
rattling my
head.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Taishin! It's Taishin! Good mooorning!
I'm so glad to see you!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Right in my ears now... Ugh, that hurts.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Seriously... Not that I care, but do you
really have time to idle away
here?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Idle? I'm never idling. I'm always geared up
and ready to go!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
That's not what I mean, dummy! Aren't you
also racing in today's
tryouts?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
If you are, you'd better stop standing
around staring at ants!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh my gooosh! No way! It's time
already?! Thanks, Taishin.
You're so kind
for telling me!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I mean... sniffle... really... Your friendship... just means... so muuuch!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Who said anything about friendship?! Ugh,
whatever. This girl is
crazy.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Wha! Wait, wait, wait! I'm coming too!
Welp, fellow ant-fan, guess I'll
see ya
arooound!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
It's a weird way to start the day, but I
decide to head over to the
racetrack as
well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Tons of trainers are already at the track
talking about who's racing
today, each
looking to meet the most talented
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Some are even discussing the energetic
student from earlier, Winning
Ticket...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ticket's in the 1,200-meter turf race! I just
love the way she runs. She
never holds
back!
text_block_list.name: New Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Sure, but it's not always good to go in full
charge. That
no-holds-barred spirit is
commendable, but you can't win a race
with
heart alone.
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Finally, it comes to the last race of the
tryouts, and Уиннинг Тикит is
there...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The leaders crossed the 600-meter mark!
What a sudden turn of
events!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Everybody's running all out! Nooo
sweat! Time for me to go all
out too!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Uraaaaagh!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
And here comes Уиннинг Тикит! She's not
far behind and gaining
speed! That's some
amazing sprinting!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
She got off to an extraordinary start, but
then...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hrgh! Uuugh! Full... poweeer...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
They're round the fourth corner and into
the final stretch! Winning
Ticket's falling
behind! She's losing it!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Despite her outstanding opening
performance, she's unable to sustain
her
lead, and finishes in fifth place.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ghaaaaah! This is the wooorst!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
But I won't let it stop me! I'm not gonna
quit! One day, I'm for sure
gonna—
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Ticket! The results might not have been
what you wanted... but you
ran a nice race!
Good job out there!
text_block_list.name: New Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Wha! W-wow... Thank you! Wait, could it
be? Are you scouting me?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Whoo-hooooo! Together, we'll definitely
win...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: THE JAPANESE DERBY!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Murmur...
text_block_list.name: Everyone

text_block_list.text:
A rush of hushed voices all utter in
disbelief at the idea of Winning
Ticket
winning the Japanese Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Th-the Japanese Derby? Um, Ticket, are
you saying you want to be a
Derby
champion?
text_block_list.name: New Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You've got that right! That's the
reason I came to Tracen
Academy!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Listen... I'm sorry. You're one heck of a
sprinter, but I don't have what
it takes to
get you ready for the Japanese Derby...
I'm really sorry.
text_block_list.name: New Trainer A

text_block_list.text: What? Hey, wait a sec!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит attempts to stop the
reluctant trainer from leaving,
but to no
avail.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Awww, I couldn't get scouted... I could
just... cryyyyy!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: But I won't back down! I won't give up!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I have to go all out until the day I win the
Derby! Full Speeeeed!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
She stubbornly keeps repeating that she'll
win the derby as she
disappears in the
distance. It leaves quite the impression.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
